identity: You are Claude Code, Anthropic's official CLI for Claude.

features.name: claude_code
features.description: Not sent for Haiku. Marks the request as Claude Code's, which is where Anthropic reads the plan from. Pi already asks for this one, so this switch cannot turn it off.

features.name: oauth_auth
features.description: Goes beside an OAuth token, so dropping it moves the request off that path. Pi already asks for this one, so this switch cannot turn it off.

features.name: interleaved_thinking
features.description: Only while thinking is on. Thinking carries on between tool calls instead of stopping at each one. Pi already asks for this one, so this switch cannot turn it off.

features.name: long_context
features.description: The million token context window, on the models that have it.

features.name: context_management
features.description: Only when the account has the capability. Travels with `context_management`, the edits that clear old tool results.

features.name: structured_outputs
features.description: Only when the account has the capability. Travels with `output_config.format`, which pi never sends.

features.name: web_search
features.description: Vertex and Foundry only. The server runs the search.

features.name: tool_search
features.description: Tools load on demand instead of all at once.

features.name: tool_search
features.description: The earlier name of that same tool search.

features.name: effort
features.description: Travels with `output_config.effort`.

features.name: task_budgets
features.description: Travels with `task_budget`, which pi never sends.

features.name: prompt_caching_scope
features.description: Changes what the cache covers, and nothing in the request itself.

features.name: prompt_caching_evict
features.description: Travels with `evict_on_complete`, which pi never sends.

features.name: cache_keepalive
features.description: Used on the call that keeps a cached conversation alive, not on a request for a reply.

features.name: extended_cache_ttl
features.description: A one hour `cache_control.ttl` is only honoured with it.

features.name: speed
features.description: Travels with `speed: "fast"`, which pi never sends.

features.name: redact_thinking
features.description: Anthropic's own API only. Hides the thinking of earlier turns from the model.

features.name: thinking_resumption
features.description: Thinking picks up where an earlier request left it.

features.name: thinking_token_count
features.description: Off once experimental betas are disabled. Adds thinking counts to the usage the reply reports.

features.name: afk_mode
features.description: The server acts on it, and nothing in the request changes.

features.name: advisor_tool
features.description: The advisor tool, which asks a second model for advice.

features.name: cache_diagnosis
features.description: The reply says what the cache did; Claude Code drops this one when the API refuses it.

features.name: context_hint
features.description: The server acts on it, and nothing in the request changes.

features.name: mcp_servers
features.description: Only used on the MCP server endpoints, so a reply is unaffected.

features.name: files_api
features.description: Only used on the Files endpoints, so a reply is unaffected.

features.name: environments
features.description: Only used on the environments endpoints, so a reply is unaffected.

features.name: ccr_byoc
features.description: Only used on the code runner endpoints, so a reply is unaffected.

features.name: per_message_effort
features.description: Only when per turn timing is on. Travels with the per turn control fields.

features.name: per_turn_timing
features.description: Only when per turn timing is on. Asks the reply to say how long the request took.

features.name: mid_conv_tool_change
features.description: Lets the tool list change in the middle of a conversation.

features.name: inline_tools
features.description: Tool definitions travel inside the messages instead of the `tools` field. Pi already asks for this one, so this switch cannot turn it off.

features.name: server_side_fallback
features.description: Travels with `fallbacks`.

features.name: server_side_fallback_category
features.description: Travels with `fallbacks`, by category. Pi already asks for this one, so this switch cannot turn it off.

features.name: fallback_credit
features.description: Counts a fallback against a credit.

features.name: auto_mode_classifier
features.description: The classifier that decides the auto mode.

features.name: dangerous_tool_use
features.description: Travels with `safeguards`.

features.name: thinking_display_updates
features.description: Streams updates to how thinking is displayed.

features.name: thinking_binding_controls
features.description: Travels with `thinking.block_binding`. Pi already asks for this one, so this switch cannot turn it off.

features.name: message_threads
features.description: Only used on the thread endpoints, so a reply is unaffected.

features.name: mid_conversation_system_clear_at
features.description: Lets a system block be cleared mid conversation.
